title: The Discount Disaster
description: discounted_price(price, discount) applies a percentage discount: discount=10 means 10% off. The math looks reasonable, but the final price is wrong.
code:
def discounted_price(price, discount):
    return price - price * discount
solution:
def discounted_price(price, discount):
    return price - price * discount / 100
explanation: The discount arrives as a percentage (10 for 10%), but the formula treats it as a fraction (0.10). The only test that passes is 0% off. Divide by 100 first. Mixing up units is one of the most common real-world bugs: always know what unit a value is in.
